activity.notes: ATLAS uses 1569 as Mercator's representative Duisburg cartographic milestone year, when his world map for navigation introduced the projection now bearing his name. Duisburg lay within the Holy Roman Empire; the higher-order existing polity is reused rather than creating a new local polity solely for this Activity.

sources.title: Gerhard Mercator — Kultur- und Stadthistorisches Museum Duisburg
sources.citation_text: Duisburg's municipal museum records Mercator's move to Duisburg in 1552 and the 1569 publication there of his navigation world map using the projection later named for him.
